summary: Solid test suite with strong coverage of core artifact retention policies, error handling, and integration testing. All three retention policies (max_age_days, keep_latest_n_per_workflow, max_total_size_bytes) are tested individually and in interaction. Dry-run/live modes and mock-based error scenarios are well-covered. Notable gaps: CLI input validation (invalid types for integers, malformed ISO-8601 dates, missing required args) is not comprehensively tested despite being present in the implementation; edge cases like empty artifact lists, zero-byte artifacts, and boundary conditions (age exactly at threshold, size exactly at budget) are untested. Workflow structure and end-to-end integration tests through act are thorough. Test organization is clean with good fixture design and test independence, though conftest.py could provide more shared fixtures. Would reliably catch regressions in core logic but might miss CLI validation or edge-case bugs.
